description:
Watch a contact's presence for `seconds` (30–300, default 120) so their "typing…/recording…" reaches the realtime inbox.
WhatsApp only delivers typing from contacts you subscribed to while you are "available", so this marks the account available while any watch is alive — and an available account stops push notifications on the paired phone. Renew (~every 60 s) only while someone has the conversation open; let it expire otherwise. Sends no message.
name: whatsapp_watch_presence
